dz: 呼拉鄂战役:中国高祖皇帝之子李世民在呼拉鄂口(河南)附近击败了杜建德在数量上优势的势力. 这一胜利决定了后苏王朝倒台后有利于唐朝的内战结果.
de: Battle of Hulao: Li Shimin, the son of the Chinese emperor Gaozu, defeats the numerically superior forces of Dou Jiande near the Hulao Pass (Henan). This victory decides the outcome of the civil war that followed the Sui dynasty's collapse in favour of the Tang dynasty.
